name: 1590A
description: Ultra-compact enclosure perfect for minimalist builds and simple circuits. Think boutique boost pedals and elegant single-knob wonders.
funny_description: Credit card sized! Perfect for when you want your pedalboard to look like a boutique jewelry collection.

name: 1590B
description: The industry standard. If you've stepped on a boutique pedal, it was probably this size. Goldilocks would approve—not too big, not too small, just right.
funny_description: The 'jeans and t-shirt' of enclosures. Classic, reliable, never goes out of style. Your pedalboard's comfort food.

name: 125B
description: Similar to 1590B but with a bit more height and breathing room. Great for when you need just a touch more space without committing to a bigger footprint.
funny_description: It's like the 1590B went to the gym and got slightly buffer. More room, same cool vibes.

name: 1590BB
description: The workhorse of complex circuits. Wide format gives you room to spread out your components without cramping your style or your soldering iron.
funny_description: Business class for your circuit. Your components get legroom, you get easier drilling. Win-win!

name: 1590BS
description: The pancake special—maximum footprint, minimum height. Perfect for low-profile builds that want to stay under the radar (literally).
funny_description: Slim Jim's cousin, Flat Fred. All the space, half the altitude. Like a sports car for pedals.

name: 1590XX
description: The penthouse suite. When you need space for everything—dual effects, elaborate tone stacks, or just want your circuit to live in luxury.
funny_description: So roomy, your resistors are asking for separate bedrooms. The mansion of enclosures.
